_comment: Valinor Smart Cuff GUI update manifest. This feed accepts only
v3.2.* releases and is intentionally separate from version.json.
The installed client needs no GitHub credential and fails silently offline.
notes:
Smart Cuff v3.2.80: longer complete-logo startup page.

The original one-second divider/reveal/signal-lock animation keeps its original speed. The complete logo page then remains visible for three additional seconds, with watchdog servicing throughout. The OLED firmware number is derived from the actual firmware revision (v3.2.38); future revision changes update the displayed number automatically. The release date uses MM/DD/YYYY (10/08/2026).

The complete logo, footer and two-pixel OLED margin remain. Existing pressure control, safety, calibration and branch-specific protocols are unchanged. Saved calibration history is retained.
